metadata.article: ARTICLE 2-1. ZONING DISTRICTS AND LOT AND BUILDING STANDARDS

content.title: 2-1-5-11. Civic building lot and building standards.
content.summary: A.	Generally. The lot and building standards that apply to civic buildings are set out in this Section. See Section 2-1-5-2, Building Types, as to which sub-districts of the OT zoning district allow civic buildings.

faqs.q: 2-1-5-11. Civic building lot and building standards.
faqs.a:
A.	Generally. The lot and building standards that apply to civic buildings are set out in this Section. See Section 2-1-5-2, Building Types, as to which sub-districts of the OT zoning district allow civic buildings. See Section 2-1-5-3, Generally Applicable Lot and Building Form Standards, regarding the application of the standards that are set out in this Section.
B.	Lot Standards. Lot standards are as provided in Table 2-1-5-11B, Civic Building Lot Standards.
C.	Building Setbacks. Building setbacks are as provided in Table 2-1-5-11C, Civic Building Setbacks.
D.	Building Placement and Building Width. Building placement and building width shall be as provided in Table 2-1-5-11D, Civic Building Placement and Building Width.
E.	Building and Floor Height. Building height, and floor height shall be as provided in Table 2-1-5-11E, Civic Building Height and Floor Height.
F.	Building Form. Building form shall be as provided in Table 2-1-5-11F, Civic Building Form.
(Ord. No. 4793, § 1, 3-21-2022)
